summary: Local profile system with SQLite persistence, CRUD API endpoints, card-style PyQt5 GUI, server status dashboard, and tutorial progress tracking implemented. Tutorial persistence failure root cause identified: game relies on HTTP backend endpoints (POST /tutorial/*, POST /game_data/save) which returned HTTP 501.

evidence: ACPP_UserDataCheckMain::BeginPlay / $IsTutorialProgress[0] on both first and second launch
